notes: Synthetic, from platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors (402 billing_error; the message is the page's description of it); request_id invented. Not recordable: it needs an organization with a billing problem.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap X4: mapAnthropicStatus maps by error type and ignores the HTTP status, so an error type it does not list falls back to 502 upstream_error, which the router retries, fails over and counts against the circuit breaker: a billing state (no credits, failed payment) is not upstream trouble, and retrying it on another key or provider hides it
